title: ind2word
summary: Map wordEncoding indices back to words.

gpu_support.notes: `ind2word` is a host vocabulary lookup and has no provider kernel.

description: `ind2word(enc, M)` returns the vocabulary words corresponding to 1-based indices in `M`.
behaviors: `enc` must be a RunMat `wordEncoding` compatibility object.
`M` may be a numeric scalar or numeric tensor of positive integer indices.
The output is a string array with the same shape as `M`.
Indices must be finite positive integers within the vocabulary size. Invalid, NaN, fractional, zero, negative, or out-of-range indices are rejected with a controlled error.

faqs.question: Does `ind2word` return missing strings for invalid indices?
faqs.answer: No. The documented input is positive integer indices, so RunMat rejects invalid or out-of-range indices.

faqs.question: Does `ind2word` execute on the GPU?
faqs.answer: No. It is a host metadata lookup.

points: `M` must contain positive integer indices within `enc.NumWords`.

gpu_residency: `ind2word` reads host text/model metadata and returns a CPU string array.
